question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who regards the whole world as his country
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cosmopolitan"** means **a person who regards the whole world as his country. **(विश्व नागरिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a **cosmopolitan** who feels at home in any city around the world.
 
 
 
• **"Cosmopolitan"** refers to someone who is free from local, provincial, or national ideas, prejudices, or attachments; at home all over the world. (विश्व नागरिक)
 
 
• **Example: **His **cosmopolitan **outlook made him a global ambassador for peace.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **Cosmopolitan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pacifist** (शांतिवादी): A person who believes that war and violence are unjustifiable.

 
 
• **Example:** As a **pacifist**, she refused to support the war effort.
 
 
 
• **Contemporary** (समकालीन): Belonging to or occurring in the present.
 
 
• **Example: **He prefers **contemporary** art over classical pieces.
 
 
 
• **Celibate** (ब्रह्मचारी): A person who abstains from marriage and sexual relations.
 
 
• **Example:** He chose to live a **celibate **life for spiritual reasons.
